title: PCB DESIGN
content: The PCB Design Course is a practical, industry-oriented program designed to teach students how to design professional printed circuit boards from basic concepts to advanced PCB layout and manufacturing preparation. Students will learn schematic creation, component selection, PCB routing, design rules, multilayer boards, 3D visualization, and preparation of manufacturing-ready PCB files.
